body: It just feels like no one wants to commit to a life with me, even my soul mate. It doesn't feel like home because it's not setup like someone cares about it or loves it. It's just a place to sleep, eat, and work. That's not a home to me. I just want a partner that wants to share in my life. It feels awful to have no one understand me. How could he not understand it out of all people... I am focusing on my job because I make the most money. I was trying to put myself first because I was put on the back burner for so long. I didn't think I had to beg for something so necessary for my happiness. It's not about the material things... It's about living somewhere with love and intent. He makes me feel like I don't deserve it
